method.rendering: Production HTML, CSS, SVG, and JavaScript bundled in-place because enterprise URL policy blocks browser navigation, except the Vite-built /customize pages, which load over real HTTP from the local dev server with the production /customize CSP (WASM and a module worker need it). The in-place check does not verify production CSP, network loading, or live provider delivery; HTTP/API behavior has separate tests.
